findings.highlight: states the question I must answer
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が出すべき答えをカタチにした
findings.governingReading: Archer gives form, more clearly than Shirou can, to the answer Shirou must give.
findings.explanation: The English reverses answer into question and weakens Archer’s role as embodying the demanded conclusion.

findings.highlight: I accepted her as a matter of course
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は当然のように甘受していた
findings.governingReading: Without knowing the pain supporting Sakura’s gentle smile, Shirou had accepted and enjoyed that smile as though it were simply due.
findings.explanation: The object shifts from the comfort Sakura’s smiles gave Shirou to Sakura herself, erasing his recognition of taking her care for granted.

findings.evidenceJa: 今まで通りにやっていけた
findings.governingReading: Shinji would not have become so distraught and they could have carried on as before.
findings.explanation: The English intensifies Shinji’s loss of composure into losing himself and omits the imagined continuation of ordinary life.

findings.highlight: The clear colors transfer into my head
findings.evidenceJa: 鮮やかな色彩に意識が移って
findings.governingReading: His attention shifts to the vivid color.
findings.explanation: The English reverses what moves and produces an unnatural claim that colors enter Shirou’s head.
The English omits Shirou’s insistence on exclusive personal responsibility.

findings.evidenceJa: その者達と戦わなくてはならなくなる
findings.governingReading: A champion of justice must fight such people—those who are evil to others.
findings.explanation: The English narrows Shirou’s general rule back to Zouken alone, weakening the rule that will also condemn Sakura.

findings.governingReading: Illya happened to call out to Shirou when she spotted him while walking through town.
findings.explanation: Spontaneous, delighted impulse becomes necessity, and her walk through town disappears.

findings.highlight: It looks like she knows about Sakura’s condition
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の容体を笑っているように見えて
findings.governingReading: To Shirou, Illya appears to be laughing at Sakura’s condition.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Shirou’s hostile misreading of Illya’s cheerful manner with the neutral fact that she seems informed.
